text:
Alex: handing off morning shift — main item is a transient CPU spike on `embed-route` at ~07:12 UTC tied to the nightly-batch job. alerts came in from IncidentBot. user-facing errors are low thanks to fallback routing but p99 latency spiked.
IncidentBot: ALERT: embed-route CPU usage > 92% on node-gpu-04 (07:12:43 UTC). Autoscaler kickstarted additional pods. Logs attached to alert.
Natalia: saw it, thanks. I scaled embed-workers to 6 replicas and bumped CPU requests for model-loader to 2.0. also disabled the large-batch executor for that route to avoid long tail.
Natalia: command I ran:
```
kubectl scale deploy/embed-workers --replicas=6 -n prod
# patched model-loader resources in prod config
```
Samir: rolled canary fallback -> `sm-embed-quantized:v1.2` (traffic 80/20). p99 dropped from ~1.8s -> 1.2s after the split.
Alex: blocker: kv-cache eviction rate spiked around the same time (~40 evictions/s). if that continues we may see stale/missing embeddings for recent items. need follow-up to increase cache footprint or tune TTL.
Natalia: actioned: increased kvcache mem on node group from 12GB -> 18GB, and set TTL=600s for hot keys. created infra ticket INF-4321 and added the stacktrace + flamegraph link: https://infra/redwood/INF-4321
Samir: also noticed a flaky test in model-loader CI that could block the hotfix. @Maya G can you triage? it's failing on CPU-mock step intermittently.
Maya G: on it — will triage now. if it's a small race I'll push a hotfix branch and coordinate a short maintenance window to deploy.
Alex: next steps for incoming shift:
  - monitor kvcache eviction rate + embed-route p95/p99 for the next 2 hours
  - confirm INF-4321 plan (memory + eviction policy) with infra
  - if CPU > 90% again, fail traffic to dedicated-hosted pool and escalate via pager
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Autoscaler stabilized at 6 replicas; no new alerts in last 10m :white_check_mark:
Samir: left notes & a timeline in the runbook (/runbooks/embed-cpu-spike.md). I can share the flamegraph if someone needs it — ping me.
Alex: thanks — handing off. Pager: +1-555-0182. pinned this thread and added the INF ticket to the handoff doc. last message ts 1989994600
